# Brand Voice Definition

`brand-voice-definition` · v1.0.0 · Design · Content & Copy
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/brand-voice-definition/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** What are the measurable rules of our brand voice, taken from writing we already agree sounds like us?

**Inputs:** Three or more pieces of writing of 100+ words that the team agrees sound like the brand, optionally pieces that do not, and any words already known to be off-limits

**Output:** Per-sample measurements, the on-brand medians and whether the samples agree, the contrast with off-brand writing, the written rules for reading level, sentence length, person, contractions, exclamation marks, hedges and words to avoid, and a profile object - avoid, prefer, maxGrade - that brand-voice-governance checks new content against

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill brand-voice-definition`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/brand-voice-definition/resources/voice-derive.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/brand-voice-definition/resources/voice-derive.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- It applies rules to the text you paste: reading grade, sentence length, person, contractions, hedges and buzzwords. It can't capture character or tone, and can't see how readers respond.
- The rules are only as good as the samples. One writer's favourites, or off-brand pieces marked on-brand, give rules for the wrong voice. Samples under 100 words are not counted.
- The agreement limits (three grades, eight words of sentence length), the grade-plus-one ceiling and the house buzzword list are AAJ engine rules, not standards.
- A word the on-brand samples use is flagged, not banned, and someone has to decide. The passive-voice figure is an estimate.

**Review before acting:** Whoever owns the brand confirms the team agrees the on-brand samples sound right and decides on every flagged word before the profile goes to brand-voice-governance. The adjectives, do/don't list and examples are still written by hand.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/brand-voice-definition](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/brand-voice-definition)
